title: Is mall world an opportunity to get our toes wet in the world of vivid dreams
content: I had a revelation last night that is just a theory, but what if mall world is just an introduction to the astral dreams we continue to go on to have? Like, say you have a year of mall world dreams, but then the locations open up more as you realize its real. You know it's a true real place and not like a regular dream, but it's like the mall world was an opportunity for our subconscious to experience and explore these type of dreams, and now the map expands. This is over a period of time. Like the mall world was just our toes getting wet into the other realms of possibility and other dreams we continue to have. I have not been to the mall itself in a few weeks, but continue to have the dreams with vivid experiences, just in way different settings.
